notes.title: v1.2.2: Full screen support
notes.notes:
Thank you very much for enjoying Soaring Machinariae.
We have made the following improvements in consideration of the actual situation and the operation of SteamDeck.

Additions:
-Full screen startup mode has been implemented.
-Added a shutdown command to the title and in-game menu.

Improvements:
-Changed the font to be more readable.
-Replaced some of the production materials.
-Fixed an issue where the mouse cursor was not automatically disappearing.
-Fixed a problem in which the mouse cursor sometimes slips through.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40569402/fffa79aeabab260a0a3e329e1a33a2767d1d2104.jpg[/img]

We hope you enjoy it!

notes.title: [20% OFF Sale]Soaring Machinariae Music Resources & Sound Tracks
notes.notes:
Dear all

You can purchase the soundtrack from to 11/2 November 2021 at a 20% off price. It is optimized for listening to music and as a game material, so please enjoy it as well.

Soaring Machinariae Music Resources & Sound Tracks
https://www.dlsite.com/home/work/=/product_id/RJ290961.html


[About the included resources]
ogg / m4a :
These datas are optimized for use as music resources.
Since LOOPSTART and LOOPLENGTH tags have already been embedded, loop playback is automatically possible on production software that supports loop tags, such as "RPG Maker MV/MZ".

mp3 :
These datas are optimized for listening. The order of the songs has been rearranged, and two loops plus a fade-out process have been added.
Tags such as album name and song title, as well as artwork images that can be displayed on various players, are already embedded.

There is no problem if you use the mp3 as a material.

notes.title: v1.2.1 released: Instant access to Challenge Mode and Music Mode!
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing.

v1.2.1 Changes
-Fixed a bug that caused Maria to get stuck on an obstacle at the entrance/exit of island town.
-Added an event in the island town for the immediate release of contents that are opened after clearing the game.
This allows for instant access to Challenge Mode and Music Mode.

In Challenge Mode, you can enjoy time attack play.
We'd love it if you'd share your records and mesmerizing plays with us via SNS or Steam's screenshot function!

Translated with www.DeepL.com/Translator (free version)
